visualReview.method: Actual view_image inspection in four pairs of all eight required card screenshots
visualReview.findings: All 11 original titles and real author/institution credits complete on desktop and native mobile fullscreen. Fence full title wraps into two lines with complete Zhu Jinjun byline. No quotations/dates/locators/hints, native-caption overlap or controls over bibliography text.

limitations: Chromium viewport emulation, not physical mobile/iOS Safari.
Only the three changed appendices play at 1x on desktop; no duplicate mobile plays or prior-batch media GETs.
Playback is muted; no human audio/ASR claim. Complete body preservation uses the baseline-SHA-bound full media receipts.
390px embedded video remains small; full reading is inspected in actual native fullscreen at 844×390 and article text.
Citation clicks prevent navigation; source verification is a separate record.
scope: Three batch-7 first appendices; derived pages, title/credit-only cards, 3 desktop 1x endings and 3 native mobile fullscreen cases. No prior-batch media or old appendix proof.
commitScope: Final integrated candidate worktree; explicit merged tag/Release/Pages identity and commit-file equality are checked separately after deployment.
